response.sql: WITH per_test AS (SELECT ID, HGB * 1.0 / HCT AS r FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0), patient_ratio AS (SELECT ID, AVG(r) AS ratio FROM per_test GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg1 FROM patient_ratio), step1 AS (SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, p.ratio - o.avg1 AS above1 FROM patient_ratio p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.ratio > o.avg1), group2 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg2 FROM step1), step2 AS (SELECT s.ID, s.ratio, s.above1, s.ratio - g.avg2 AS above2 FROM step1 s CROSS JOIN group2 g WHERE s.ratio > g.avg2) SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(above1) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(above2) AS avg_above_second FROM step2;

assumptions.assumption: A test's ratio is computable only when HGB and HCT are both non-NULL and HCT is non-zero; each patient's ratio is the mean of their computable per-test HGB/HCT ratios.
The 'average ratio across all patients' is the unweighted mean of the per-patient ratios (each patient counts once), not the mean over every individual test.

The second average is the mean of the per-patient ratios of the first kept group, and 'the ratio' in the final row is each final patient's per-patient ratio. Patients with no computable ratio are excluded entirely.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average is the mean over every individual computable test ratio (test-weighted) instead of the mean of patient ratios. Patients are still kept and averaged at the patient level.
alternatives.sql: WITH per_test AS (SELECT ID, HGB * 1.0 / HCT AS r FROM Laboratory WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT <> 0), patient_ratio AS (SELECT ID, AVG(r) AS ratio FROM per_test GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(r) AS avg1 FROM per_test), step1 AS (SELECT p.ID, p.ratio, p.ratio - o.avg1 AS above1 FROM patient_ratio p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.ratio > o.avg1), group2 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg2 FROM step1), step2 AS (SELECT s.ID, s.ratio, s.above1, s.ratio - g.avg2 AS above2 FROM step1 s CROSS JOIN group2 g WHERE s.ratio > g.avg2) SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(above1) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(above2) AS avg_above_second FROM step2;
